name: Gemini Client
description: Multi-version Fabric utility / sandbox client (Minecraft 1.7.10 – 26.2+) with 269 modules, glassmorphic ClickGUI, draggable HUD, VersionBridge mechanics, and built-in Baritone 3D A* pathfinding.

custom.gemini:baritone: Hooks baritone.api.BaritoneAPI when present and ships a built-in 3D A* engine (#goto, #mine, #follow, #tunnel, #farm, #explore, #excavate, #sel, #thisway, #axis).
custom.gemini:versions: Supports Minecraft 1.7.10 – 26.2+ via VersionBridge profiles, GeminiMixinPlugin soft injectors, and optional ViaFabricPlus protocol detection.
